laws.rule: A state of emergency has been declared in the 'Macro Zona Sur': the provinces of Biobío and Arauco in the Biobío Region, and the Araucanía Region, until further notice. The military has been deployed to assist regional police there.

Parque Nacional Nonguén: The operator requires visitors to be back at the administration by 17:00 or an emergency protocol is triggered. Cold-food picnic areas are available; there is no electricity or mobile-phone signal. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Parque Nacional Nonguén: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.

Parque Nacional Nonguén: smoking is prohibited in CONAF's published unit conditions. The same page prohibits consuming drugs or hallucinogenic products; no wider possession or prescribing rule is inferred.
